decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several categories of backpacks including ultralight hiking (Granite Gear), hydration-focused (N NEVO RHINO), technical winter (USWE), sling (NICGID), and cooler-style (SEEHONOR). However, the selection had significant drawbacks. The Granite Gear and Hebetag packs had concerning reports of straps tearing under load. The hydration packs received mixed reviews regarding bladder durability and noise. The USWE Hajker is a high-quality technical pack but felt overpriced at over $200 for my current needs. Given that nearly half the search results were irrelevant items like paddle boards, stoves, and towels, and the remaining backpacks had quality or pricing issues, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
